title: Registers: grouping qubits by their role
objectives: Describe input, target and workspace registers.
Expand a multi-register state with declared dimensions.
prerequisites: Chapters 3–6: tensor products, unitary gates, joint-state order, coherent control and measurement.

quizzes.question: Two input qubits plus one target have how many joint basis states?
feedback: Three is the number of qubits.

quizzes.question: Does naming registers X and Y imply their joint state factors?
options: Only if the diagram uses separate wires.
feedback: Correct: use a joint state when factorization fails.
Separate wires do not establish a product state.
